practicals.title: Experiment 1
content: Study of Theodolite – Identify various parts of theodolite and their
functions

practicals.title: Experiment 2
content: Temporary Adjustments of Theodolite – Perform setting, centering,
leveling, and focusing

practicals.title: Experiment 3
content: Horizontal Angle by Repetition – Measure horizontal angle using
repetition method

practicals.title: Experiment 4
content: Horizontal Angle by Reiteration – Measure multiple horizontal
angles using reiteration method

practicals.title: Experiment 5
content: Vertical Angle Measurement – Determine vertical angles using
theodolite

practicals.title: Experiment 6
content: Elevation by Trigonometry – Find elevation of objects using
trigonometric method

practicals.title: Experiment 7
content: Contour Survey – Conduct fieldwork and prepare contour map
(project)

practicals.title: Experiment 8
content: Tacheometric Constants – Determine multiplying and additive
constants

practicals.title: Experiment 9
content: Errors in Surveying – Demonstrate instrumental, personal, and
natural errors

practicals.title: Experiment 10
content: Weights to Observations – Solve examples on assigning weights to
observations

practicals.title: Experiment 11
content: Total Station – Demonstration of setup and working of total station

practicals.title: Experiment 12
content: Photogrammetry & Plane Table – Study aerial photogrammetry and
plane table methods (radiation, intersection, traversing)
Total Hours 28
